_about: Card packs (src/delivery/packs.js; the spec: BLUEPRINTS-NOTES.md 'Card packs', PACK-DEFINITIONS-DRAFT.md, CHECKLIST items 115 and 154). ONE DEFINITION PER PACK: everything about a pack (its rules, its featured cards, the event it belongs to, what gives it, its Shop offer and price) is its entry in `packs`; nothing about a pack is anywhere else (shop.json is the currency only; events.json names nothing about packs). Every number here is the owner's to tune. rarities: lowest to highest, with the colour a card shows. odds: the weight of each rarity for a plain slot (rolled among the rarities the pack's pool has cards of; a rarity with no cards in the pool is skipped and its share goes to the others). ladder: the rarity of a garage car's blueprint card by its star tier (gold / blue, tiers 1 to 5; null = no cards, the 1-gold starters); a car's own `rarity` field is read first; goldOneBlueprint: the card of a 1-gold BLUEPRINT car. featuredRarity: the rarity a featured blueprint card shows when its car has no card rarity of its own; otherwise a featured card keeps its TRUE rarity, and a featured key is Bespoke. doubleChance: the chance each NON-featured card that drops DOUBLES its stack (n = base x 2), a pack's own `doubleChance` overrides it; never a key, never a featured card. sections: the Shop's rows, top to bottom (id, name, note). packs (the key is the pack's id, saved in the save's packs held and its purchase counters): name; size = cards a pack; baseAmount = copies of its card every non-featured slot gives before any doubling (1 for the normal packs, 2 for the LIMITED ones); amounts (optional) = { rarity: n } over baseAmount; limited: true = a LIMITED pack (an event's), base 2; pool 'evergreen' (the cards always in the pool, never an event car, never a key) or 'all' (evergreen plus the Bespoke keys not owned); bespokeBlueprints: true = the Bespoke key cars' Legendary blueprints are in the pool too; atLeast = { rarity: n } (at least n cards of that rarity or better; the last slots rolled again); event = a special event's id (events.json special): the pack is on sale (and listed) only while that event is on; featured = the featured-card mechanic: upgradeChance (each slot but the last upgrades), featuredChance (each entry's own roll when a slot upgrades), entries (a car id = weight 1, or { car, weight, amount, key }; the last slot is a featured card picked by weight; an exhausted entry, car maxed or key owned, is out and the others' weights shift; left out: its event's prize car at weight 1); givenBy = what gives it free: career { every: n (every nth level of the main list), levels: [ids] } (a pack on the first delivery of those levels), event { stage: true (one a stage done the first time), prize: true (one with the grand prize), id (optional: the event, else the pack's own `event`) }; shop = its Shop offer (no shop block: never sold, only given): section, price (in the placeholder currency; 0 = FREE, its button 'Claim'), was (an old price struck through), ribbon ('featured', 'sale', 'new', 'best'), limits { total: n (how many may EVER be bought), daily: n (how many a day: the player's local calendar day by the device clock, reset at local midnight) } (either or both; left out: unlimited); blurb (optional) = words over the generated one (packs.js describePack builds it from the rules: never hand-typed). bundles: a pack x a count at a price: pack, count, price, was, ribbon, section (default 'bundles'), name (optional; default '3 Standard packs'), blurb (optional); each pack of a bundle counts toward the pack's limits. log: how many opened packs the save keeps.
